children: According to CNBC, SoftBank Group shares jumped more than 7% on Thursday after Japanese markets reopened following a three-day holiday and the company announced an $11.1 billion bond issuance to help finance its investment in OpenAI. SoftBank said it sold $10 billion of dollar-denominated senior notes and 1 billion euros, or $1.14 billion, of euro-denominated notes, with proceeds earmarked for a $10 billion payment tied to the third and final tranche of its $30 billion follow-on investment in OpenAI, which is expected to close Oct. 1, as well as general corporate purposes. The financing comes as SoftBank continues to expand its artificial intelligence push under CEO Masayoshi Son. The company agreed to the $30 billion investment in February, which would lift its cumulative investment in OpenAI to $64.6 billion and give it an approximately 13% stake once completed.

title: SoftBank Group Jumps More Than 7% After $11.1 Billion Bond Sale to Fund OpenAI Bet
